entities.name: Battle at Argoth
entities.description: Open warfare using the most advanced artifact creatures on both sides, ending with Urza filling the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Drove all artifact creatures in both armies mad with Phyrexian corruption and wounded Ashnod.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Gaea's champion who fought the Colossus of Sardia.

entities.name: Colossus of Sardia
entities.description: Giant artifact creature that died fighting Titania.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Found Tawnos and gave him the Golgothian Sylex; wounded by Gix.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Urza filled with his memories of the land.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra who filled the Sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, altered by Phyrexian constructs, who fused with a dragon engine.

entities.name: Dragon engine
entities.description: Machine Mishra fused his body with.

events.summary: Gix drives all artifact creatures in both armies mad with Phyrexian corruption of metal.
events.quote: With Phyrexian corruption of metal, Gix drove all of the artifact creatures in both armies mad, creating absolute havoc.

events.summary: Titania and the Colossus of Sardia fight and both die.
events.quote: Titania had become Gaea 's champion, and had a titanic battle with the Colossus of Sardia , resulting in the death of both.

events.summary: Ashnod gives Tawnos the Golgothian Sylex; Gix wounds her but she survives.
events.quote: Ashnod found Tawnos , and handed him the Golgothian Sylex .

events.summary: Tawnos brings the Sylex to Urza with the message to fill it with his memories of the land.
events.quote: Tawnos then raced to Urza and gave it to him

events.summary: Mishra taunts Urza's aging; Urza realizes Mishra has not aged and sees his machine parts.
events.quote: Urza finally understood that his brother had been altered by Phyrexian constructs.

events.summary: Mishra fuses with a dragon engine as Urza fills the Sylex with his memories of the land.
events.quote: Urza picked up the Sylex and poured his memories of the land into it.

relations.quote: Urza finally understood that his brother had been altered by Phyrexian constructs.
